# @three-ws/avatar-cli

> Terminal-native tooling for on-chain avatars: scaffold, validate, hash, and preview avatar manifests from your shell or CI.

@three-ws/avatar-cli is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/avatar-cli`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/avatar-cli/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/avatar-cli/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/avatar-cli/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/avatar-cli/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
